scripts._comment:test:emulator: Firestore-backed repository tests ONLY. Kept out of `test` so the fast suite stays emulator-free: those tests compile to lib/emulator/, which the `lib/*.test.js` glob does not recurse into. Java: the Firestore emulator needs a JRE and macOS ships only a stub `java` shim, so PATH is prefixed with homebrew's JDK (`brew install openjdk`). If your JDK lives elsewhere, prefix PATH yourself or edit the path below. The project id is the reserved `demo-` prefix, which makes the tooling offline-only and unable to reach a real Firebase project. firebase.json binds the emulator to 127.0.0.1:8080; if `localhost` resolves to ::1 on your machine, swap FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST to 127.0.0.1:8080.
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --only firestore --project demo-monthly-story 'FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:8080 node --test lib/emulator/*.test.js'
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
